evidence_sentence: It then determines the maximum number of columns across all images.
rationale: The vulnerable implementation allocates and initializes each thread's pixel channels using only image->columns. The fixed implementation adds traversal of the linked image list to compute the maximum columns value across all images before allocation and initialization. The quoted Logic sentence specifically describes that fixed-only traversal and bound calculation.
rewritten_docstring: The function first retrieves the maximum number of threads allowed and allocates memory for an array of pixel channel pointers. It then determines the number of columns to use for the pixel channel arrays. For each thread, it allocates memory for the pixel channels and initializes them to zero. If any allocation fails, it cleans up previously allocated memory and returns NULL.
